challenge_facts_addressed.effect_on_judgment: Regular initiation and approximately weekly one-on-one meetings over twelve weeks provide substantial evidence of sustained relational interest, reducing confidence in B.
Helping with an important interview and attending an important birthday dinner demonstrate effort and responsiveness beyond purely passive involvement.
Independently resuming contact after two periods apart indicates durable interest and weighs against viewing the involvement as merely convenient.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: B remains somewhat better supported because Casey twice declined to define the relationship without offering a timeline, generally favored short-notice or geographically convenient meetings, canceled two advance plans for other commitments, avoided close-circle integration, and declined planning two months ahead. However, C2-F1 through C2-F3 show meaningful consistency and effort, so the distinction is not decisive and confidence is reduced.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: The mixed pattern supports asking directly about desired commitment and future expectations rather than inferring them solely from either Casey's consistent contact or reluctance to define and plan.
